sanskrit_verse:
सुरापी व्याधिता धूर्ता वन्ध्यार्थघ्न्यप्रियंवदा ।
स्त्रीप्रसूश्चाधिवेत्तव्या पुरुषद्वेषिणी तथा ॥७३॥
transliteration: surāpī vyādhitā dhūrtā vandhyārthaghnī apriyaṃvadā / strīprasūścādhivettavyā puruṣadveṣiṇī tathā // YajñS_1.73 //
sph_interpretive_translation: A woman who is addicted to alcohol, diseased, deceitful, barren, harmful to others' purposes, speaks unpleasantly, has given birth to a daughter, or harbors hatred towards men—such a woman must be known and dealt with accordingly.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The observer of dharma holds the capacity to recognize and respond to misalignment without external mandate.
Causation: Behavioral and constitutional conditions that disrupt social harmony are identifiable and addressable through conscious observation.
Capacity-based responsibility: One's ability to act in alignment determines their inclusion or exclusion from certain relational or societal roles.
Restoration logic: Identification of imbalance precedes the possibility of realigning consciousness toward dharmic order.
Consciousness alignment: Recognition of distortion enables the individual and society to restore clarity and purpose.
executable_legal_axioms: IF subject.is_female AND (subject.consumes_alcohol_excessively OR subject.has_contagious_disease OR subject.exhibits_deceitful_behavior OR subject.is_medically_unable_to_conceive OR subject.speaks_harmfully OR subject.bore_female_child OR subject.holds_antagonism_towards_men) THEN observer.must_acknowledge_and_act;
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, this verse establishes the threshold for recognizing individuals whose conduct or condition poses a disruption to societal dharma. The court does not punish but identifies and initiates protocols for consciousness realignment. Authority lies not in condemnation but in precise recognition of energetic and behavioral misalignment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based observation reveals causal patterns in behavior and constitution. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how prolonged misalignment manifests in form and action. Responsibility is proportional to awareness; hence separation is not punitive but protective. Reality remains non-punitive as consciousness itself adjusts through natural consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Subject undergoes guided self-reflection to understand root distortions.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Subject acknowledges impact of condition on collective harmony.
Capacity Restoration: Subject engages in practices aligned with raising sattva and clearing rajas/tamas.
Integrity Reintegration: Upon verified transformation, subject may be reintegrated with safeguards.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores balance through recognition, not punishment. Consciousness is the ultimate judge, and reality responds only to truth—not vengeance. Dharma prevails.
